Name: Beehouse Config Extensions
Author: MoorTarPetal
Description:
Fine-tune honey outputs in Content Patcher!

This mod allows for changes in bee house outputs for individual items:
﻿- Minimum flowers required to produce honey of that flavor
﻿- The base price and price modifiers given to the flavored item
﻿- Alternative items other than honey that get produced
﻿- Maximum distance from the beehouse it can be

In addition, flower ids can be attributed to wild trees and fruit trees (i.e. blossom) and the number of flowers that tree counts for can be changed.

Giant crop counts are based on the items it can spawn, not the harvest item of the crop it's from.

If you are using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10996]Better beehouses[/url] be aware that any flowers included in this mod will be limited by the radius set (MoorTarPetal.BeehouseConfigExtensions.Radius). If you're set to get wild honey and  Betterbeehouses has picked up a flower that has a count limit and is outside of the radius, you will still get wild honey!
